title: 第1924章 再见温弦乐李云凡上门第1923章 陈稳离开了姬圆圆的怀疑
slug: 被问罪当天无上帝族杀来
content_zh:
半天后。
传送阵停了下来，陈稳从传送空间中走了出来。
此时，一老者迎了上来，“大人，您这边请。”
“不知您是？”
陈稳看着眼前的老者，不由开口道。
“李顺，领主府的管事，领主他不在府里，让老奴替你安排好一切。”
李顺开口道。
陈稳点了点头，“不知道传送阵安排好了没有？”
是的。
其实在回来之前，他就已经与李相羽沟通好了。
目的是为了节省时间。
谁也不知道洛如画的消息什么时候来。
“已经安排好了，不过大人您这般急吗，老奴已经为您准备好住食了。”
李顺不由开口道。
陈稳笑了笑道，“你有心了，跟你们领主说一声，小子下一次再来拜访他。”
“也行，那大人随老奴这边来。”
李顺丢下一句话后，便朝着另一个方向走去。
很快，陈稳便随之来到了一处传送阵前。
“这是给您准备好的，如果您赶时间，现在就可以进去了。”
李顺开口道。

“好，那就让他们开始吧。”
陈稳丢下这句话后，便转身进入了传送阵中。
李顺一见，立刻示意阵法长老启动传送阵。
陈稳转瞬便消失在眼前。
转眼半天过去。
传送阵再一次停下来。
只不过这次传送到的地方是登天商会。
在他刚出来后，便看到了温弦乐。
将近一个月不见，佳人依旧。
而陈稳自己也已经变回了本来的样貌。
“还顺利吧。”
温弦乐在陈稳的身上扫了一眼，然后开口道。
“算顺利吧。”陈稳想了想然后道。
温弦乐没由来地说了一句，“我怎么感觉你有些不太一样了？”
陈稳微微一一怔。
这就是女人的第六感吗？
content_en:
Half a day later.
The teleportation array stopped, and Chen Wen walked out of the teleportation space.
At this time, an old man came forward and said, "Sir, please come this way."
"I wonder who you are?"
Chen Wen looked at the old man in front of him and couldn't help but say.
"Li Shun, the steward of the lord's mansion. The lord is not in the mansion, so let me arrange everything for you."
Li Shun said.
Chen Wen nodded, "I wonder if the teleportation array has been arranged?"
Yes.
In fact, he had already communicated with Li Xiangyu before coming back.
The purpose is to save time.
No one knows when the news about Luo Ruhua will come.
"It has been arranged, but are you in such a hurry, sir? I have already prepared accommodation and food for you."
Li Shun couldn't help but say.
Chen Wen smiled and said, "If you are interested, tell your lord that I will come to visit him next time."
"That's okay, then, sir, come with me."
After Li Shun said a word, he walked in another direction.
Soon, Chen Wen came to a teleportation formation.
"This is for you. If you're in a hurry, you can go in now."
Li Shun said.
"Okay, let them begin."
After Chen Wen said these words, he turned around and entered the teleportation array.
When Li Shun saw it, he immediately signaled the formation elder to activate the teleportation array.
Chen Wen disappeared from sight in an instant.
Half a day passed in the blink of an eye.
The teleportation array stopped again.
It's just that the place teleported to this time is the Dengtian Chamber of Commerce.
Just after he came out, he saw Wen Xingxing.
We haven’t seen each other for nearly a month, but the beauty is still the same.
Chen Wen himself has also changed back to his original appearance.
"It's going well."
Wen Xingxing glanced at Chen Wen and then said.
"Consider it going well." Chen Wen thought for a while and then said.
Wen Xingxuan said for no reason, "Why do I feel that something is different about you?"
Chen Wen was slightly startled.
Is this a woman’s sixth sense?
